implementation.selector: MK61_LINKED_VM_COMPACT=0 for A, =1 for B; defaults to 1 only inside the separately opt-in MK61_LINKED_VM_POC resident path.
implementation.shared_logic: Two compile-time specializations of one member-transition loop, not another VM implementation. Both invoke the identical pinned LANGVM kernel.
implementation.whole_path: Fresh, unlimited calls of already verified whole LBV2 members, directly from immutable raw bytes or a non-null cache loan. No Slice or paged Reader construction, no INPUT-resume or instruction-budget machinery on this entry.
implementation.line_map: LBV2-only raw 32-bit record lookup. Check the program epoch before touching image bytes, including source-line reporting after a callback invalidates/frees an image.
implementation.preserved: The common cold verifier, container/member CRCs, immutable catalog, callback epoch checks, bindings/stack bounds, overflow/error handling, service polling, ESC handling and loan release on every exit remain.
implementation.suspension: INPUT/LIMIT still publish the original continuation. The whole entry rejects an already suspended session without modifying it. The universal execute_with entry can resume it explicitly; no implicit restart or paged fallback.
implementation.unchanged_scope: The native PoC still accepts only the cold loader's <=8192-byte whole members and has no production INPUT/editor handoff. Generic LBV1/LBV2, paged execution and budgeted resumptions remain available separately.
implementation.storage: No new allocation or static cache. Existing compiler prefix, numeric banks, 32-KiB page cache and 8-KiB loan eligibility are unchanged. The cold loader remains in VMSTORE.APP.

sizes.symbol_evidence: Generic resident has Slice::read (128 bytes) and the general line lookup plus its helpers (366 bytes). Compact resident has neither; whole_lookup is 150 bytes. Native verifier/inspect symbols are absent from the compact resident. These symbol sizes are not an additive attribution of the full LTO image delta.
sizes.historical_note: The previously measured uninstrumented PoC was 375624 bytes. Use the freshly rebuilt same-tree generic 375592-byte control for the 448-byte claim; do not attribute the shared-refactor/code-generation difference to the compact selector.

experiment.kernel_arithmetic_on_hardware: BINARY64; CORE additionally tested with real unmodified chess on the host.
experiment.scenario: Level 2, depth 8, book off, playing Black; e2e3, 420 nodes and complete eight-rank golden board.
experiment.clock: Unchanged host wall-clock driver: OK at Black selection -> first CRC-checked complete board. USB Screen continuously attached in every stage. No profiler or KEYWAIT timing instrumentation enabled.
experiment.statistics: Three searches per stage after a matched reset. Discard the first, use the median of the two warm repeats. Reference is the mean of the two A medians.

results.conclusion: 448 bytes less internal Flash, no global-RAM or maximum-frame growth, and a small observed 0.47-percent warm-search improvement. The working set/cache work is identical. This is primarily compaction, not a large VM speedup or a headless/cold-start claim.
